newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica prices rise 1.3 percent during October.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica prices rise 1.3 percent during October.

text.p: Costa Rica's consumer prices rose 1.3 percent during October after climbing 0.91 percent the previous month, Economy, Industry and Trade Minister Jose Leon Desanti said on Tuesday.
Inflation during October 1995 was 2.98 percent. Prices have risen 15.48 percent in the 12 months since then, Desanti said a news conference.
Cumulative inflation in the first 10 months of 1996 was 11.53 percent, versus 18.37 percent in the same period last year, Desanti said.
Price increases for bread, tomato, eggs, coffee, telephone service, rent and gasoline contributed to the rise, he said.
